rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance – rent control coverage
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to most multifamily units built before 1980, to single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and to rooming houses. Newer buildings, condos, and later single-family tenancies are not subject to the rent limits.
rules.requirement_es: El control de alquileres se aplica a la mayoría de las unidades multifamiliares construidas antes de 1980, a las casas unifamiliares con arrendamientos iniciados antes de 1996 y a las casas de huéspedes. Los edificios más nuevos, los condominios y los arrendamientos posteriores de casas unifamiliares no están sujetos a los límites.
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.coverage_conditions: Most multifamily units built before 1980; single-family homes with tenancies beginning before 1996; rooming houses. Not covered by rent limits: new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family tenancies beginning on or after Jan 1, 1996, most condominiums, certain subsidized units (Section 202/811, HUD-insured projects).
rules.exemptions: Golden duplex (owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979); owner shares kitchen/bath; ADU properties with owner occupancy (tenancies after Nov 7, 2018); university units; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.caveat: Secondary guide table; citation is the ordinance chapter and not stated in the document. Table says 'before 1980' and 'after June 1980', leaving a gap; the cutoff date is approximated.

rules.title: Berkeley Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance – coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause eviction protections apply to fully and partially covered Berkeley units, including newer buildings, condos, and post-1996 single-family tenancies. Only exempt units (such as golden duplexes, shared-kitchen/bath owner units, university housing, and nonprofit co-ops) are excluded.
rules.requirement_es: La protección de desalojo por causa justificada se aplica a las unidades total o parcialmente cubiertas de Berkeley, incluidos edificios nuevos, condominios y arrendamientos unifamiliares posteriores a 1996. Solo se excluyen las unidades exentas (dúplex 'golden', unidades donde el dueño comparte cocina/baño, vivienda universitaria y cooperativas sin fines de lucro).
rules.quoted_span: Most condominiums** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.coverage_conditions: All units except exempt categories; newer construction and condominiums remain covered by just cause.
rules.exemptions: Golden duplex; owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant; ADU property with owner-occupied unit (tenancies after Nov 7, 2018); university rental units; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.caveat: Guide table only covers coverage, not the allowed causes or procedures; citation not stated in document.

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest requirement – coverage
rules.requirement: Landlords of fully or partially covered Berkeley units must pay interest on security deposits. Exempt units (e.g., golden duplexes, university housing, nonprofit co-ops) are not covered.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores de unidades total o parcialmente cubiertas en Berkeley deben pagar intereses sobre los depósitos de seguridad. Las unidades exentas (p. ej., dúplex 'golden', vivienda universitaria, cooperativas sin fines de lucro) no están cubiertas.
rules.quoted_span: Single-family home with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.coverage_conditions: All fully and partially covered units; interest rate and amount not stated.
rules.exemptions: Golden duplex; owner shares kitchen or bath; ADU property with owner-occupied unit; university units; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.caveat: Guide table only shows whether security deposit interest applies; rate not given; citation not stated in document.
